customer_name: King Abdullah Financial District Development & Management Company
business_problem: KAFD DMC needed to maintain 24x7 uptime for a fast-growing district with tens of thousands of assets, while coordinating contractors, spare parts, and service requests across a vast mixed-use development without losing service quality for tenants and visitors.
solution_summary: KAFD DMC chose IBM Maximo Application Suite as the core asset-management platform for the King Abdullah Financial District and implemented it with IBM partner eSolutions. The deployment was designed to mirror KAFD's operating model while scaling with district growth, so the team loaded asset and location data, integrated Maximo with ERP, CRM, and BIM systems, and used the suite to orchestrate maintenance end to end. Today, tenants submit requests through an online interface, Maximo turns them into work orders, dispatches contractors, manages spare parts and warehouses, and tracks SLA-backed progress. For critical assets, Maximo Health combines sensor readings, asset records, meter data, and work histories into custom health scores so the team can open work orders before conditions deteriorate. The result is a single platform for reactive, preventive, and predictive maintenance across one of the world's largest urban developments.

solution_components.name: IBM Maximo Application Suite
solution_components.role: Coordinates service requests, work orders, contractor dispatch, spare-parts management, and maintenance workflows across the district.

solution_components.name: Maximo Health
solution_components.role: Scores asset health from readings and histories so KAFD can detect deterioration early and trigger proactive maintenance.

data_flow: Service requests from tenants enter Maximo through an online interface, where they are converted into work orders and routed to contractors, while asset readings, work histories, and meter data feed Maximo Health to generate health scores that open proactive maintenance actions when conditions worsen.
business_outcome: KAFD DMC improved customer satisfaction and work-order closure speed while building a scalable digital-maintenance backbone for a growing district and its 24x7 service expectations.
metrics: 85% improvement in time to close work orders
architecture_clues: The deployment followed a full SDLC process from requirements analysis through go-live.
KAFD's best-of-breed IT strategy depended on Maximo's expandable integrations with third-party ERP and enterprise systems.
Maximo Health uses custom performance scores derived from meter readings and other data to trigger proactive work orders.
